description: Squarespace offers Commerce and Reseller REST APIs, webhooks, custom code and an MCP server for developers.
auth_notes: Generated API keys for custom applications on a merchant's own site, or OAuth 2.0 for registered OAuth clients (required for Squarespace Extensions).
gate_detail: API keys require the Commerce Advanced plan. OAuth requires registering an OAuth client that is reviewed and approved; listing in Extensions is a separate process. No sandbox stated.
api_scope: Commerce APIs read and write orders, products, inventory, transactions, contacts and discounts; Reseller APIs provision sites and domains; Webhook Subscriptions API available via OAuth only.
mcp_notes: Vendor-hosted remote MCP server on developers.squarespace.com docs; Domains tools without sign-in, Commerce tools after OAuth 2.1 sign-in in Claude and ChatGPT.
blocker_detail: OAuth clients must be reviewed and approved; the API-key path needs a paid Commerce Advanced plan.

evidence.quote: you can use a generated API key or start the OAuth process with Squarespace to become a registered OAuth client.
With Squarespace's Commerce Advanced plan, you can develop a custom application for a Squarespace merchant site.
Registering an OAuth client, and having it reviewed and approved, only allows OAuth connections with Squarespace.
Read and write orders, products, inventory, and transactions. REST endpoints, webhooks for order events, and signed payloads for safe server-to-server delivery.
Squarespace uses OAuth 2.0 to authorize third-party applications to integrate with Squarespace and consume Squarespace APIs.

uncertainties: No sandbox or test environment is described.
Whether OAuth client approval is routine or selective is not stated.
